subject: Post-discovery: choose two 30-min walk-through windows & nominate ops/executive
content:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@orchardhealth.com>, Tom Blake <t.blake@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: choose two 30-min walk-through windows & nominate ops/executive

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Really enjoyed the call this morning — thanks for diving into the current infra constraints and the three priority use cases. Quick recap so we’re aligned before we schedule the product walk-through:

- Goal: 30-minute, customer-facing product intro focused on inference economics and security controls.
- Key criteria you called out: predictable latency under 200ms P95, dedicated capacity option, and audit logs for model usage.
- Stakeholders you said would likely attend: Tom (infra/ops) + a brief exec sponsor (you mentioned Kate as a possible exec).

Next step: propose two 30-minute windows next week so we can lock a short demo that covers the technical flow + a short decision checklist for procurement. Can you confirm which of these work for your group and who will join?

Option A: Tue Jul 6 — 10:00–10:30 PT
Option B: Wed Jul 7 — 14:00–14:30 PT

If neither of those work, please suggest two alternate 30-minute blocks. Also, please confirm if you want us to include a quick security/controls review (we can bring our Security PM) or keep it strictly product/ops. Attached: discovery-notes.pdf (short call recap).

Thanks — I’ll hold both windows tentatively until I hear back.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (summary, 1 page)

-----
From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@orchardhealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Blake <t.blake@orchardhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: choose two 30-min walk-through windows & nominate ops/executive

Thanks Lauren — great recap.

We’re available for both windows in principle, but Tom prefers the Wed slot. Tentative attendee list:
- Tom Blake (Infra/Platform) — will share any infra constraints ahead of the call
- Kate Lin (VP Product) — exec sponsor, may join the second half

Wed Jul 7 14:00 PT is our preference. If you can hold that, we’ll lock it on our side.

Also — we have a GDPR/compliance question. Could you have someone briefly cover data residency and audit logging? If that’s feasible, we’ll invite our compliance lead.

Best,
Samantha
Senior IT Program Manager, Orchard Health
samantha@orchardhealth.com

-----
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-discovery: choose two 30-min walk-through windows & nominate ops/executive

Thanks — quick internal note before you lock Wed 7th:
- I’m available Wed Jul 7 14:00 PT and can present the infra/ops flow (how we handle dedicated pools, KV cache, and autoscale).
- Recommend we include a 5-minute slide on security/controls (data residency, KMS integration, audit logs) — I can pull that together; attaching the internal ops checklist for the demo run-through.
- We should call out the SLA/latency profile in the invite so their exec sees we’re aligned on performance targets.

Attachment: demo-ops-checklist.docx

Ping me if you want me on the calendar invite as well.

— Priyom
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com

-----
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@orchardhealth.com>, Tom Blake <t.blake@orchardhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: choose two 30-min walk-through windows & nominate ops/executive

Great — Wed Jul 7, 14:00–14:30 PT is locked. Inviting Priyom to present the ops flow and we’ll include a 5-minute controls segment for your compliance lead.

Calendar invite: orchard-demo-invite.ics (attached)
Agenda (brief)
1) 0–5m: quick intro & goals (Lauren)
2) 5–20m: product walkthrough — inference runtime, routing, and batching (Priyom)
3) 20–25m: security controls & data residency (Priyom)
4) 25–30m: next steps & mutual action plan (Lauren)

Prep: Tom — if you can share any non-sensitive telemetry or top-of-stack requirements before the call that would help us tailor the walkthrough. I’ll add the SLA/latency targets to the invite notes.

Locking the invite now — Calendly link for adjustments: https://calendly.com/lauren-redwood/intro-30

Thanks everyone — look forward to it.

Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: orchard-demo-invite.ics (calendar invite)
